description: This file contains utility functions for quantization transformations in PyTorch, specifically handling int4 packing/unpacking, weight reordering for mixed datatype linear operations, and related tensor manipulations used in quantized neural network models.

methods.name: pack_int4_to_int8(weight)
methods.description: Packs pairs of int4 values into a single int8 tensor, with first int4 in lower bits and second in higher bits.

methods.name: unpack_int8_to_int4(weight)
methods.description: Unpacks an int8 tensor into pairs of int4 values, separating lower and upper 4 bits.

methods.name: quantized_weight_reorder_for_mixed_dtypes_linear_cutlass( weight, dtypeq, transpose=False )
methods.description: Reorders and optionally transposes the weight tensor for efficient use with CUTLASS-based quantized linear operations, supporting different datatypes and device placement.
